recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片可見大片嗜酸性壞死區，其中散布核碎片（karyorrhexis）與發炎細胞，周邊有血管與脂肪空泡；此倍率看不到病毒包涵體，僅能看出壞死性淋巴結炎。
features: Extensive geographic eosinophilic necrosis with fibrinous appearance
Abundant scattered nuclear debris (karyorrhexis) and inflammatory cells within necrosis
Denser cellular area toward one side with mixed small cells
Blood vessels and round fat vacuoles within the tissue
Viral inclusions not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Lymph node section at low to medium power shows extensive eosinophilic necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris and scattered inflammatory cells. A more cellular area is present along one side, and vessels and fat vacuoles are seen within the tissue. Viral cytopathic changes cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are those of a necrotizing lymphadenitis; in context, herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis is favored, pending higher-power review for intranuclear inclusions and HSV immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Kikuchi necrosis lacks neutrophils and viral inclusions and is rimmed by crescentic histiocytes, with negative HSV immunostaining.
Lupus shows hematoxylin bodies and Azzopardi phenomenon with vasculitis, and serologic evidence of SLE.
Ghost outlines of large atypical cells in necrosis and viable lymphoma at the edge, confirmed by IHC, indicate lymphoma rather than infection.
